title.value: AB 1817, Ting. Product safety: textile articles: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).
title.provenance: AB  1817,  Ting.  Product  safety:  textile  articles:  perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: (e)  'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a  class  of  fluorinated  organic  chemicals  containing  at  least  one  fully  fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.

who.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.

action.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions (exempt until January 1, 2028)

items excluded from the definition of "textile articles" such as carpets and rugs, treatments containing PFAS for use on converted textiles or leathers, vehicles, vessels, filtration media, laboratory textile articles, aircraft, stadium shades, etc.
exceptions.provenance: does not apply to outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028.  "Textile articles" does not include any of the following: (A) ... Carpets and rugs. (i) Carpets and rugs. (ii) Treatments containing PFAS for use on converted textiles or leathers. (B) A vehicle ... (C) A vessel ... (D) Filtration media ... (E) Textile articles used in or for laboratory analysis and testing. (F) An aircraft ... (G) Stadium shades or other architectural fabric structures.

type.provenance: no person shall distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS unless it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure with the statement 'Made with PFAS chemicals,'

action.provenance: no person shall distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS unless it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure

products.provenance: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions

type.provenance: A manufacturer of a textile article shall provide persons that offer the product for sale or distribution in the state with a certificate of compliance stating that the textile article is in compliance with the requirements of this chapter and does not contain any regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.
